verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA26218533 from Pune Diecast Works to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318760 (2026-10-05). Two lines for CMP-GAM-010 Statue "The Getaway": 2,800 pcs confirmed for 2026-12-21 and 2,400 pcs confirmed for 2026-12-28, both at 1037 INR. Incoterms FOB Nhava Sheva, NET30. The document states the supplier is approved for serial supply (PPAP submitted 2026-09-14).
red_flags: The same material CMP-GAM-010 appears on two lines with different confirmed dates (total 5,200 pcs); the document does not say whether this is a split delivery.
The document states no unit of measure for the quantities, and no document date.
The unit price 1037 is shown with no per-unit basis stated, and no totals are given.
observations: Clean typed PDF; no handwriting, stamps, strike-throughs or signatures.
The document has no explicit issue date; only the customer order date (2026-10-05) and the PPAP submission date (2026-09-14) appear.
